hardware: 8x NVIDIA H20-3e; one independent server and workload per GPU
streaming_usage_policy: Request include_usage and continuous_usage_stats; accept completion-token counts only from server usage objects; fail closed on explicit streaming error objects; allow an empty decoded text only for the one-token cache-prime request

environment.installation: prebuilt isolated node-local venv from pinned official CUDA 12.9 wheels; exact pip freeze and pip check retained before model output

processor_view.policy: run-private copy of the six frozen tokenizer/config files plus the hash-pinned official Qwen3.5 preprocessor_config.json; original model directory remains unchanged
processor_view.readiness_probe: successful /model_info response followed by the workload client's real OpenAI completion warmup

phases.cache_off: fresh server with --disable-radix-cache; extra_buffer scheduling retained
phases.cache_on: fresh server with radix cache enabled; document-only priming before measured document+query

metrics: request-level cached tokens and Prometheus token counters
